sections.html:
Novaflex Metal Roof Sealant Almond provides unbeatable adhesion to metal, coated metals, wood, masonry, PVC and most common construction substrates.

This product adheres to: Lap Joints, Metal Siding, Single-Ply, Roof Flashing, Pipe Boots, Metal Roof, Gutters, Downspouts, Trim, PVC, Aluminum, Roof Tile, Copper [in exposed areas only], Snow Guards, Stucco, Termination Bars

***12 Cartridges/Tubes per case. Individual cartridges/tubes are available for purchase***
